title: Model form, every combination tried, and feature importance

text.finding:
**Model form (ftir_54).** On the locked lowest-OC/EC 800 cohort with corrected spectra, PLS holds held-out IMPROVE R² 0.904 against 0.53–0.77 for the other four forms, and all 15 fits put the Addis intercept (against Fabs/10) below zero (−4.1 to −0.6 µg/m³). Where the truth is known (inside IMPROVE), PLS extrapolates best: at the spectral edge it keeps slope 0.81 while the trees fall to 0.21–0.27. Addis sits inside the 800-cohort envelope (4 % beyond the PCA D² p95, 1 % beyond the PLS D² p95).

**Every combination tried (ftir_55).** The explorer's cache held 20,869 Addis configurations; 413 passed the core guardrails (held-out R² ≥ 0.85, slope 0.7–1.3) and 355 all five, every one of them in the lowest-OC/EC family (Deming against HIPS Fabs/10; 2nd derivative: 34 pass, best score 1.68 at cutoff 450, k = 20, 1.02x − 1.57; baseline-corrected: 321 pass, best score 1.72 at cutoff 440, k = 9, 0.98x − 1.62). The 2nd-derivative row scores best but is a manual-k row that does not transfer to Bishoftu; the baseline-corrected one is the vetted winner.

**Feature importance (ftir_07, ftir_08).** The IMPROVE EC and OC models share 179 of their top-200 VIP wavenumbers (Spearman r 0.934); the IMPROVE and Addis HIPS models share 0 (r 0.797).

**HIPS as the target (ftir_08).** Trained on IMPROVE HIPS optical depth (k 1, chosen on held-out sites), the model predicts Addis Fabs with slope 0.22 and bias −33.0 (median 15.0 against 47.1 observed) on 239 filters; an Addis-only model reaches nested-CV R² 0.883, RMSE 3.82. Fabs against Fabs: no MAC enters.
